metadata.title: Nanopore sequencing identifies parent-of-origin specific age-associated methylation changes at imprinted loci in the human genome
metadata.description:
Summary Statistics Data for the manuscript "Nanopore sequencing identifies parent-of-origin specific age-associated methylation changes at imprinted loci in the human genome".

Supplementary Data Description

Supplementary Table 1 – deCODE summary statistics - CpGs info

Summary statistics of all 22,178,471 autosomal CpGs showing whether they are high-quality and if not, why they failed. Genomic positions are 0-based.

Chrom: chromosome

Start: start coordinate

End: end coordinate

Ratio: Average methylation levels

Passed_strandBias: binary column indicating whether the CpG passed strand bias filter

Passed_fractionReliable: binary column indicating whether the CpG passed fraction of reliable reads filter

Passed_coverage: binary column indicating whether the CpG passed coverage filter

 

 

Supplementary Data 2 – deCODE summary statistics - Age associations information

Summary statistics from linear regression of methylation on age for 3,739,875 autosomal CpGs that reached Bonferroni significance (p-value<2.8∙10-9=0.05/18∙106). Genomic positions are 0-based.

Chrom: chromosome

Start: start coordinate

End: end coordinate

Intercept: intercept calculated from linear regression model

Effect_size: effect size calculated from linear regression model

Std_err: standard error calculated from linear regression model

T_val: standard error calculated from linear regression model

P_val: p-value calculated from linear regression model

 

 

Supplementary Data 3 – deCODE summary statistics - DNAmAge information

Summary statistics for methylation aging clock, including the intercept and coefficients for 1,373 CpGs with non-zero regression coefficient in the lasso regression model. Genomic positions are 0-based.

Attribute: Name of the attribute in model, either intercept or CpG name on the format chrom_start_end

Coefficient: Value of coefficient or intercept.

 

Supplementary Data 3 – deCODE summary statistics - DNAmAge information with additional columns

Summary statistics for methylation aging clock, including the intercept and coefficients for 1,373 CpGs with non-zero regression coefficient in the lasso regression model. Genomic positions are 0-based.

Attribute: Name of the attribute in model, either intercept or CpG name on the format chrom_start_end

Coefficient: Value of coefficient or intercept.

Mean: The mean value of each feature in the training data (scaler.mean_). Can be used with scale to standardize the data.

Scale: Standard deviation of each feature in the training data (scaler.scale_). Can be used with mean to standardize the data.


 

 

Supplementary Data 4 – deCODE summary statistics - Haplotype resolved age-associations

Summary statistics from linear regression of haplotype resolved methylation on age for 1,274,315 autosomal CpGs that reached Bonferroni significance (p-value<2.8∙10-9) on one of the parental haplotypes. Genomic positions are 0-based.

Chrom: chromosome

Start: start coordinate

End: end coordinate

Mean_M: mean methylation levels of maternal haplotype

Mean_P: mean methylation levels of paternal haplotype

Coef_M: effect size for maternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

Coef_P: effect size for paternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

P_val_M: p-value for maternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

P_val_P: p-value for paternal haplotype calculated from linear regression mode

Stderr_M: standard error for maternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

Stderr_P: standard error for paternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

 

 

Supplementary Data 5 – deCODE summary statistics - Imprinted CpG information

Summary statistics from 702 CpGs that reached Bonferroni significance (p-value<3.9∙10-8) in difference between the effect sizes for maternal- and paternal haplotypes, calculated using two-sided z-test. Genomic positions are 0-based.

Chrom: chromosome

Start: start coordinate

End: end coordinate

Mean_M: mean methylation levels of maternal haplotype

Mean_P: mean methylation levels of paternal haplotype

Coef_M: effect size for maternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

Coef_P: effect size for paternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

P_val_M: p-value for maternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

P_val_P: p-value for paternal haplotype calculated from linear regression mode

Stderr_M: standard error for maternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

Stderr_P: standard error for paternal haplotype calculated from linear regression model

Cpgs: CpG name

Z: z-value for effect size comparison

P: p-value for effect size comparison

Hap: Significant haplotype

Unmet: unmethylated haplotype

Allele: Methylation status of allele

Met_dif: Absolute difference between mean_M and mean_P

Est_dif: Absolute difference between coef_M and coef_P

title: Nanopore sequencing identifies parent-of-origin specific age-associated methylation changes at imprinted loci in the human genome
